settings.heading: Build your Independence Phone setup.
settings.body: Start with the Patriot Package, or choose your phone, plan, and add-ons below.
settings.package_value: Patriot Package - $250; Classic Phone, 1 year phone service, and all 4 add-ons (saves $303.12)
settings.package_descriptor: Take advantage of our limited offer honoring the 250th anniversary of America. Includes Classic Phone, 1 Year phone service, all 4 add-on's for only $250! A savings of $303.12.
settings.checkout_note: Taxes, shipping, and recurring billing are finalized through the approved store setup. Savings shown here are based on the selected setup options.

settings.question: What gets billed at checkout?
settings.answer: The chosen phone, service, and add-ons are added to the cart when the matching billing products are configured. Taxes, shipping, subscriptions, and any final bundle logic still depend on the approved Shopify or Rev.io setup.

settings.question: How are savings shown?
settings.answer: Annual service, the add-on bundle, and the Patriot Package show savings descriptors in the order builder and cart so the customer can see the value of the selected setup.
